widgets_values:
Drive a LingBot World 2 world live from an image. Queue the prompt, then click the Reactor Realtime window and steer: W and S move forward and back, A and D strafe, Q and E orbit, and the arrow keys look around. Edit the prompt in that window and press Apply to change the weather, the light or what happens. Press Done to save the take under reactor/realtime, or Cancel to drop it.

The prompt is the resting form the LingBot World 2 prompt guide gives for one fixed prompt: the world, then the camera, then the subject at rest. Copy example_inputs/reactor_jet_ski_cruise.jpg from this plugin into ComfyUI's input folder first. Set your Reactor API key in this plugin's config.ini.

widgets_values: A man in a red life vest on a white and red jet ski on turquoise water near a sandy beach lined with palm trees. The world contains EXACTLY ONE rocky outcrop on the horizon at a fixed position. Sunlit coastal atmosphere with light glinting off the calm sea. Third-person view, the jet ski locked at the exact centre of the frame at constant size and distance. Neither the jet ski nor the camera moves on its own; arrow-key look-input is the only source of camera motion, arcing the camera around the stationary, centred jet ski only while held. The man sits on the idling jet ski, hands on the handlebars, the hull bobbing gently on the swell as small ripples lap against its sides.

widgets_values_named.prompt: A man in a red life vest on a white and red jet ski on turquoise water near a sandy beach lined with palm trees, a distant rocky outcrop on the horizon. Sunlit coastal atmosphere with light glinting off the calm sea. Strict third-person rear view, the man on the jet ski locked at the exact centre of the frame as the camera holds a fixed position behind him and tracks him forward.
